editorial:
Imagine turning seventeen and having your big surprise party turn into a total nightmare. That is exactly what happens to Michael when his friends decide to play around with a Ouija board. Instead of getting some harmless answers, they accidentally wake up a mean demon named Virgil. The vibe is very much like those classic eighties horror movies where a group of teens makes one bad choice and everything goes wrong. You get to see Michael struggle with scary dreams and flashes of the future while Virgil starts picking off his friends one by one. It is a wild ride that blends teen drama with supernatural scares, making you feel the panic as the body count rises.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing about who will be targeted next. While some of the acting is a bit over the top, it fits the style of the era perfectly. The pacing is quick, so you will not get bored, though some of the special effects look a bit dated now. If you love old-school slashers with a demonic twist, you should definitely check this out. Since it is a hidden gem, your best bet is adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for the best picture, or just renting it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Michael has to face Virgil to stop the killing spree. He uses his premonitions to stay one step ahead of the demon. After a tense battle, Michael manages to banish Virgil back to where he came from by using the same connection the Ouija board created. The movie ends with the remaining survivors shaken up, knowing that messing with the spirit world can have deadly consequences that almost cost them their lives.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s supernatural horror and teen slashers.
